notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, enforcement boundaries, and non-duplication alignment with prior Brain audit patterns.

change_log.value: Clarified MongoDB enforcement (collection-level + repository guard) and explicit field list for audit schema.
Added deterministic ordering guarantee and idempotency handling for repeated writes.
Expanded instrumentation scope to include external API adapters and ensured correlation_id propagation via request context.
Clarified access control as backend-internal միայն and added pagination constraints.
Expanded tamper scenarios to include partial chain corruption and concurrent write race conditions.

stories.title: Adopt Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract (Align with Brain)
stories.description: Align debug_logger output to a standardized audit schema (timestamp, actor, action_type, tool_name, payload metadata, correlation_id, previous_hash, current_hash). Enforce append-only via dedicated MongoDB collection (no update/delete permissions) and repository-layer guards that reject mutation attempts. Define write-once semantics and access constraints.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; ASSUMPTION: Brain audit schema standard exists; GAP: formal schema mapping spec

stories.title: Append-Only Logging Engine with Hash Chaining
stories.description: Implement audit logging engine with deterministic hash chaining (previous_hash → current_hash), strict ordering guarantees, and idempotent write handling. Enforce insert-only persistence through a dedicated abstraction layer.

stories.title: Audit Instrumentation Across Tooling and Services
stories.description: Instrument tool_router, safety_service, provider_search_service, clinical_trials_service, and external API adapters to emit structured audit events. Ensure consistent correlation_id propagation across request lifecycle via shared context.

stories.title: Internal Audit Log Read API with Integrity Verification
stories.description: Implement backend-internal read/query interface for audit logs with filters (correlation_id, time range, action_type), pagination, and optional full-chain hash verification. Restrict access to internal services only.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing read/query interface in debug_logger

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Tamper Detection
stories.description: Extend test_debug_logger to validate append-only enforcement, hash chain continuity, concurrent write ordering, and tamper scenarios (altered, deleted, reordered, and partially corrupted chains). Include integration tests from tool_router through persistence.
